name: agentcore-observatory
description: Read-only visibility into your Amazon Bedrock AgentCore deployments. See every runtime's state, which evaluators and online-evaluation configs are attached, and what is actually measurable — with the gaps labelled as gaps instead of shown as zeroes. Point it at an AWS profile name and a region; credentials are resolved by the aws CLI and never read or stored here.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Runtime, version and endpoint state for every AgentCore runtime in a region
Online-evaluation configs shown next to the evaluators they run, including the ones switched off
Profile name and region only — no credential is ever read, written, or cached
An authorization failure is reported as one, never as an account with nothing deployed
Read-only: every call is a list verb, and agent sessions are refused by the cloud chokepoint
